admission.justification: The decision determines which layer supplies an omitted mode and which layer can reject a named mode for a role start.

alternatives.option: Use the applicable launch selection and the host's advertised default, and delegate mode acceptance to Paseo.
alternatives.reason: Paseo already owns the mode system for each harness, and a settings row's mode belongs to the harness it names.

alternatives.option: Derive a least permissive mode in the product and reject values absent from the product's copy of the offers.
alternatives.reason: This would duplicate Paseo's mode system and make the product choose modes on behalf of a different harness.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The launch contract can no longer obtain a harness default or leave mode acceptance to Paseo, and the developer revisits mode ownership.

consequences: The launcher can send a permission mode for one start. Profile and settings modes apply on their own harness.
A known mode listing supplies the host-advertised default only when no higher applicable source names a mode. Create omits mode when no choice applies.
Receipts distinguish the requested mode and the host observation.
context: A role start needs to pass the selected harness a suitable mode. The product previously derived a least permissive choice and rejected an unlisted name using its copy of the offered modes.

evidence: notes/DEVELOPER-DIRECTION.md D853 and D854; requirements/BUG-R11-v1-a-role-agent-starts-in-its-permission-mode.md; notes/MANAGER-RULINGS.md M609.
